description: This file defines the Recipient class within the OrangeHRM leave email module. The class models an email recipient with properties for email address, name, and first name, providing getter methods for each.

classes.name: Recipient
classes.description: Represents an email recipient with contact details used in leave notification emails.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Recipient object with an email address, name, and first name.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the email address of the recipient.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the recipient.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the recipient.
